dedupeText: neon retro futurist disco aesthetic checkered floor jukebox neon glow 80s disco trapezoidal frame backlit silhouette the red and blue neon glow from the jukebox defines the silhouette and highlights of the central figure the receding perspective of the checkered floor creates depth against the flat trapezoidal frame the typography is split between the top left and top right balancing the visual weight of the central subject combine checkered perspective floor neon jukebox light source trapezoidal framing ultra wide swashed typography to recreate this 1980s disco funk aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast scene featuring a central figure leaning against a glowing vintage jukebox on a black-and-white checkered floor, framed by a trapezoidal perspective mask with neon-lit typography in the upper corners.
coreVisualRelationships: The red and blue neon glow from the jukebox defines the silhouette and highlights of the central figure.
The receding perspective of the checkered floor creates depth against the flat trapezoidal frame.
The typography is split between the top-left and top-right, balancing the visual weight of the central subject.
coreInvariants: Black and white checkered floor in perspective
Trapezoidal central framing with light gray border wings

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure and jukebox occupy the middle 60% of the frame, scaled to show full body and machine.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit jukebox serves as the primary light source and visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-left typography, follow the figure's lean down to the jukebox, and exit through the top-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The light gray trapezoidal 'wings' on the left and right provide neutral negative space that pushes the central action forward.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and stark white (checkered floor and background).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant neon red/magenta and electric blue/cyan from the light sources.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale lavender and gold/yellow used for the typographic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the floor tiles; high saturation in the light blooms against dark shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid natural daylight; colors must feel artificial and electric.

letterConstructionRules: Initial letters feature long, sweeping horizontal swashes that underline or overline subsequent characters
Heavy weight with rounded outer corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'D' and 'J' have elongated tails that stretch horizontally across the top margin.

typesetting.alignment: left and right justified to corners
typesetting.lineBreakPattern: two-line stack on left, single line on right

composition.relationshipToImage: floating above the scene within the trapezoid

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast a heavy, swashed display face on the left with a cleaner, italicized sans-serif on the right.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 80s techno-futurist width and weight.
Necessary for the specific long swashes on initial characters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a person with an afro hairstyle leaning against a glowing 1950s-style jukebox. The floor is a black and white checkered pattern in sharp perspective. The lighting is dark with strong red and blue neon highlights. Frame the entire scene inside a black trapezoid with light gray borders on the left and right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-wide, italicized custom lettering in the top corners. Use a lavender color for the left-side text and a gold-to-yellow gradient for the right-side text. Ensure the first letters have long horizontal tails.

verificationChecks: Is the checkered floor in correct perspective?
Does the jukebox emit both red and blue light?
Is the typography ultra-wide and slanted?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the model

mustAchieve: Sense of depth through floor pattern

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red and blue lights don't wash out the subject's silhouette.
Ensure the checkered floor lines converge toward a single vanishing point.
Verify the typography feels integrated into the 80s retro-futurist style.
Confirm the trapezoid mask is symmetrical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Checkered Perspective Floor] + [Neon Jukebox Light Source] + [Trapezoidal Framing] + [Ultra-Wide Swashed Typography] to recreate this 1980s disco-funk aesthetic.
